title: Specify consent and permissions as a first-class cross-cutting capability
requirements:
- Give consent and authorisation a service profile comparable to named components: representation, lifecycle, revocation, delegated authority, audit
- Split the combined row into distinct capabilities with their own purposes
- Clarify that data carries or references policy and consent metadata evaluated against the current authoritative record
- Specify consent representation, lifecycle, enforcement and interfaces across DPI-H
- For centralised, federated and hybrid exchange, state where consent status is checked and when
- Address purpose-of-use and attribute-based access control
- Distinguish consent from legal basis and from authorisation
- State whether a consent capability is a named shared component or a pattern
